title: Intern, Automotive Design - Spring 2027
note: Full-time transportation design internship for students who have completed at least 60 credit hours with a 3.0+ GPA; no relocation help.

facts.duties: Help the automotive design team with proposals for BMW Group brands, support new-business pitches and help the visualization team with presentations.
facts.requirements: Enrolled in a bachelor's or master's in transportation, automotive or industrial design; 3.0 GPA; 60+ credits done; portfolio showing sketch-to-concept process; US work authorization; background check.
facts.apply: Apply online through the BMW Group careers page.
